subject: Amazon reseller launch — sprint checklist & gaps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Amazon reseller launch — sprint checklist & gaps

Team —

Putting this thread together so we have a single source of truth for the AWS CPPO launch with CloudWave. Goal: get reseller-signed LOA, submit CPPO request to AWS, map SKUs and billing codes, and schedule a technical handoff before the 12/06 go-live.

Attached: CPPO_Activation_Checklist.xlsx (workbook with tasks & owners)

Initial gaps I see: 
- LOA: CloudWave says legal needs a short template from us to attach to their LOA (they can sign this week).
- CPPO template: we need Soojin to confirm SKU mapping and pricing code (billing tag).
- AWS partner manager (Aisha Khan) wants expected private-offer start/end dates + estimated monthly commit.
- DocuSign: procurement wants a signed reseller addendum + LOA in DocuSign.

Proposed immediate actions (short sprint):
1) Rishi: send CPPO template + example DocuSign link to CloudWave by EOD today.
2) Lauren: coordinate trial pricing band and estimate MRR for AWS PM (share numbers to HubSpot).
3) Soojin: produce SKU mapping sheet and confirm billing tags by Tue 11/24.
4) Sergio: prepare a 30-min technical kickoff for CloudWave and AWS (propose 11/29 or 12/01).

Please reply with any blockers. I will loop in CloudWave once we have items 1–3 ready.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--- attachment: CPPO_Activation_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Amazon reseller launch — sprint checklist & gaps

Thanks Rishi — quick notes: 

- I'll pull last quarter's similar resell reports to justify the pricing band. Expect to send a recommended tier breakdown (three bands) by Mon 11/23.
- For the MRR estimate I need CloudWave's expected seat/usage projection. Diego, if you can share a conservative 3-month forecast that would speed this up.
- Legal: we should avoid changing the standard CPPO commercial terms. If CloudWave needs an LOA template, attach a short confirmation letter (one page) rather than broad contract language.

On the HubSpot side, I'll create the deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/847 and tag it CPPO-reseller.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Partner Sales
Redwood Inference

Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@amazon.com>, procurement@cloudwave.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Amazon reseller launch — sprint checklist & gaps

Hi Rishi / Lauren —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few points from CloudWave's side: 

- LOA: I'm attaching our standard reseller LOA but legal prefers you provide a short template to sign and return so they can bundle. See attachment CloudWave_LOA.pdf.
- Forecast: we'll provide a conservative 3-month usage projection in a separate spreadsheet by tomorrow (11/24).
- CPPO timing: AWS PM (Aisha) asked for exact start/end dates and a monthly commit amount to include in the private-offer request.
- Kickoff: happy to do 11/30 at 10am ET for the technical session; confirm and we will invite our solutions engineer.

Also: we need the DocuSign link for the reseller addendum. If you can send the DocuSign template we will sign the LOA the same day it arrives.

Best,
Diego Ramos
Head of Partnerships
CloudWave Solutions

--- attachment: CloudWave_LOA.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Ramos <diego@cloudwave.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@amazon.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Amazon reseller launch — sprint checklist & gaps

Diego / Aisha —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Action items and confirmations: 

1) DocuSign: sending CPPO reseller addendum for signature: https://docu.sign/rw-cppo-template (placeholder). Diego — once CloudWave signs the LOA and the addendum we will submit the CPPO to AWS.
2) Dates: Target private-offer window 2026-12-06 to 2027-06-05 (6-month commitment). If that works for CloudWave, please confirm the monthly commit number in the 11/24 forecast.
3) SKU mapping: Soojin — can you prepare the SKU->Redwood billing tag mapping and attach to the HubSpot deal by EOD 11/24? That is required for AWS to wire the billing configuration.
4) Tech kickoff: Sergio — please propose 30-min slots for 11/30 (10am ET) or 12/01 (1pm ET).

I attached a baseline CPPO_Template.docx (boilerplate) to speed legal review.

I'll hold off on the official CPPO submission until we have the signed LOA + addendum and the forecast.

Thanks,
Rishi

Ack — I'll have the SKU mapping and billing tags in the HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/847) by COB Tue 11/24.

Notes for the mapping:
- We'll use SKU prefix RW-RES-; map CloudWave's internal usage tiers to our SKU tiers (pilot, standard, enterprise).
- Need CloudWave's product codes for the first 3 SKUs (Diego, please include in the forecast email).
- I'll also add a short runbook section for how billing reconciliation will work in the first 30 days.

— Soojin
